summary: ADR-0068 removed dist/dotnet/.config/dotnet-tools.json from the Kit roster. The file remains .github's canonical local tool manifest, including the engine-pin-coherence subject, while each receiver owns its own manifest. The current registry has no kit config row for this file; stage-kit derives the config roster from that registry and derives build-config files from sync-build-config.sh FILES, which contains only Directory.Build.props and Directory.Packages.props. Therefore changing FAKE or Fantomas in this manifest updates the shared source baseline but does not deliver those tool versions through Kit materialization or establish installed adoption. Refresh the real receiver manifest and tool runtime when accepting each consumer. Some older build documentation and script comments still describe prior manifest delivery; the accepted ADR and derived roster define this boundary. This record grants no publication or receiver mutation.
title: The shared tool manifest is not distributed by the Kit package
